arxiv-1802-04117.title: Review of Smart Meter Data Analytics: Applications, Methodologies, and Challenges
arxiv-1802-04117.creator: Yi Wang, Qixin Chen, Tao Hong, Chongqing Kang
arxiv-1802-04117.description: Abstract The widespread popularity of smart meters enables an immense amount of fine-grained electricity consumption data to be collected. Meanwhile, the deregulation of the power industry, particularly on the delivery side, has continuously been moving forward worldwide. How to employ massive smart meter data to promote and enhance the efficiency and sustainability of the power grid is a pressing issue.

arxiv-1911-12362.title: Example-Guided Scene Image Synthesis using Masked Spatial-Channel Attention and Patch-Based Self-Supervision
arxiv-1911-12362.creator: Haitian Zheng, Haofu Liao, Lele Chen, Wei Xiong, Tianlang Chen, Jiebo Luo
arxiv-1911-12362.description: Abstract Example-guided image synthesis has been recently attempted to synthesize an image from a semantic label map and an exemplary image. In the task, the additional exemplar image serves to provide style guidance that control the appearance of the synthesized output. Despite the controllability advantage, the previous models are designed on datasets with specific and roughly aligned objects.

arxiv-2006-15958.title: Investigation of Soft and Living Matter using a Micro-Extensional Rheometer
arxiv-2006-15958.creator: Sushil Dubey †, Sukh Veer †, Seshagiri Rao R V †, Chirag Kalelkar #, Pramod A Pullarkat †*
arxiv-2006-15958.description: Abstract Rheological properties of a material often require to be probed under extensional deformation. Examples include fibrous materials such as spider-silk, high-molecular weight polymer melts, and the contractile response of living cells. Such materials have strong molecular-level anisotropies which are either inherent or are induced by an imposed extension.

arxiv-2202-10533.title: Dynamic Sampling Rate: Harnessing Frame Coherence in Graphics Applications for Energy-Efficient GPUs
arxiv-2202-10533.creator: Martí Anglada, Enrique de Lucas, Joan-Manuel Parcerisa, Juan L. Aragón, and Antonio González
arxiv-2202-10533.description: Abstract In real-time rendering, a 3D scene is modelled with meshes of triangles that the GPU projects to the screen. They are discretized by sampling each triangle at regular space intervals to generate fragments which are then added texture and lighting effects by a shader program.

arxiv-2208-06929.creator: Alfred Dolich and John Goodrick
arxiv-2208-06929.description: Abstract . We study the structure of infinite discrete sets D D definable in expansions of ordered Abelian groups whose theories are strong and definably complete, with particular emphasis on the set D ′ D^{\prime} comprised of differences between successive elements.

arxiv-2302-05413.title: The mirage of luminal modified gravitational-wave propagation
arxiv-2302-05413.creator: Antonio Enea Romano, Mairi Sakellariadou
arxiv-2302-05413.description: Abstract Using conformal invariance of gravitational waves, we show that for a luminal modified gravity theory, the gravitational-wave propagation and luminosity distance are the same as in general relativity. The relation between the gravitational-wave and electromagnetic-wave luminosity distance gets however modified for electromagnetism minimally coupled to the Jordan frame metric.

arxiv-2404-10155.title: The Fault in our Stars: Quality Assessment of Code Generation Benchmarks
arxiv-2404-10155.creator: Mohammed Latif Siddiq, Simantika Dristi § , Joy Saha §, Joanna C. S. Santos
arxiv-2404-10155.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are gaining popularity among software engineers. A crucial aspect of developing effective code generation LLMs is to evaluate these models using a robust benchmark. Evaluation benchmarks with quality issues can provide a false sense of performance.

arxiv-2503-11631.title: Surface instabilities in laminar compressible boundary layers with sublimation
arxiv-2503-11631.creator: Blaine Vollmer 1, Alberto Padovan, 1, Daniel J. Bodony 1
arxiv-2503-11631.description: Abstract Surface patterns on ablating materials are observed in high-speed ground and flight tests, but the mechanisms behind their formation are not known. In this paper, the origin of surface patterns is investigated via a local linear stability analysis of compressible laminar boundary layers over a flat camphor plate.

pmc-11399079.title: Achieving excellence with interdisciplinary approaches in complex orthodontic adult patients
pmc-11399079.creator: Ute E. M. Schneider, Lorenz Moser
pmc-11399079.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Over the last decades the percentage of adult orthodontic patients has substantially increased. Undeniably, an important motif for seeking orthodontic care at an older age is smile improvement, but this is not all. Frequently, impaired dentofacial aesthetics are combined with several other issues: severe dentoskeletal malocclusions; multiple tooth loss due to caries or endodontic failure; dental agenesis or trauma; periodontal breakdown; or functional problems, such as temporomandibular disorders or obstructive sleep apnoea.

pmc-11584624.title: Two decades of body length measurements of larval and juvenile fish populations in English rivers
pmc-11584624.creator: Rachel F. Ainsworth, Lauren H. Vickers, Jonathan D. Bolland, Marie J. Taylor, Jon P. Harvey, Richard A. A. Noble, Ian G. Cowx, Andy D. Nunn
pmc-11584624.description: Long-term datasets provide context and understanding of complex ecological processes, including temporal variations in species diversity and ecosystem dynamics. This dataset is comprised of body length measurements (mm) of more than 380,000 larval or juvenile fish of 30 species from five English river catchments collected almost monthly over two decades.

pmc-12830605.title: CCL8 suppresses ovarian cancer progression via M1 macrophage polarization and NF-κB-mediated apoptosis
pmc-12830605.creator: Jie Fang, Xinyue Zhao, Jin Wang, Yaping Yang, Yujia Xiao
pmc-12830605.description: CCL8, a chemokine overexpressed in ovarian cancer (OC), has drawn attention for its role in tumor progression. This study aimed to explore the function of CCL8 in OC and its effects on tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) and related mechanisms. Bioinformatics analysis revealed a correlation between high CCL8 expression and M1 macrophage infiltration, as well as a favourable prognosis in OC patients.

pmc-13225415.title: DSE-YOLO11: Dynamic feature adaptation for key traffic element detection in complex road scenes
pmc-13225415.creator: Yange Chen, Baohua Guo, David Bassir, Anthony Sigama, Yuandi Zhang
pmc-13225415.description: Accurate detection of key traffic elements in complex road scenes is critical for autonomous driving and intelligent transportation systems. However, existing lightweight detectors often suffer from missed detections under small targets, large-scale variations, and cluttered backgrounds. To address these challenges, we propose DSE-YOLO11, a RAD-oriented lightweight adaptation of YOLO11n that integrates DynamicConv, SlimNeck, and EMA in a stage-wise collaborative manner.

pmc-13375156.title: Lymphocytic Esophagitis Mimicking Eosinophilic Esophagitis and Esophageal Candidiasis: A Case Report
pmc-13375156.creator: Hiroshi Sugawara, Makoto Eizuka, Yosuke Toya, Ryo Sugimoto, Shunichi Yanai, Yuki Yasumi, Naoki Yanagawa, Takayuki Matsumoto
pmc-13375156.description: A 59‐year‐old man presented with a 5‐year history of progressive dysphagia. Esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD) revealed an esophageal stricture with adherent whitish exudates, and biopsy specimens demonstrated fungal elements. Subsequent EGD showed longitudinal furrows, concentric rings, and white exudates, mimicking eosinophilic esophagitis. Biopsy specimens revealed marked intraepithelial lymphocytic infiltration without eosinophils.

pmc-13388031.title: Case Report: A rare adult case of ELANE-related severe congenital neutropenia revealed by neutropenic enterocolitis
pmc-13388031.creator: Zhenhua Jiang, Diya Wen, Yuanyuan Liu, Mingyue Shi, Qiuyu Liu, Yanliang Bai
pmc-13388031.description: Severe congenital neutropenia (SCN) is a rare hematologic disorder characterized by recurrent and potentially life-threatening infections beginning in early childhood, associated with absolute neutrophil counts (ANCs) below 0.5×109/L. Mutations in the ELANE gene are the most prevalent cause of SCN. Gastrointestinal complications such as neutropenic enterocolitis (NE) are rarely reported as presenting manifestations of congenital neutropenia.

pmc-13536959.title: Quality of life, depression and sexual function in men living with HIV under effective antiretroviral therapy compared with healthy controls
pmc-13536959.creator: Özlem Güler, Demir Akhan, Gamze Kara Sözen, Sıla Akhan
pmc-13536959.description: PurposeCombination antiretroviral therapy (cART) has improved outcomes in individuals living with HIV. This study investigated quality of life, mental health, and sexual function in virologically suppressed men.Patients and methodsThis case-control study compared quality of life, depression, and sexual function of 39 heterosexual men on cART with viral suppression and 60 healthy male controls.

pmc-13588309.title: From Bench to Bedside: Evolving Definitions of Translational Research
pmc-13588309.creator: Hana A. Alhumud, Fars K. Alanazi, Edward B. DeVol
pmc-13588309.description: SummaryObjective:To synthesize current evidence on the evolution, frameworks, and methodological approaches used to define and operationalize translational research, which serves as a bridge between scientific discovery and its application in clinical medicine, public health, and policy.Methods:We systematically searched PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science for peer-reviewed studies published up to 2023.

pmc-13626458.title: Reclaiming Rights and Justice: Migrant Mobilization and Collective Resistance in Canada
pmc-13626458.creator: Siyuan Yin
pmc-13626458.description: Migrant rights and justice movements in Canada have arisen within an increasingly hostile political and discursive environment marked by restrictive immigration policies, precarious labor regimes, and the racialized marginalization of migrant communities. Yet these conditions have also generated various forms of collective resistance that contest the exclusionary boundaries of citizenship, labor rights, and national belonging.
